name: Shiori
message: "There should be a lot of kids living here, since it's a housing complex. We might even find our ghost too."

name: Shiori
message: "—I guess that was a little too optimistic of me. Of course she's not here."

name: Shiori
message: "That mother from the other day..."

name: Shiori
message: "She's noticed us too. Let's go say hello."

name: Mother
message: "Hello."

name: Shiori
message: "Hello."
"Hello."

name: Mother
message: "Micchan, you say hello too~. Your friends came to see you again~!"

name: Mother
message: "Ehehehe, looks like Micchan's getting a little shy."

name: Mother
message: "Okay Micchan, say goodbye to your friends now~. Bye bye~!"

name: Mother
message: "Thank you, you two. But I'm sorry, we have to go shopping now. We really appreciate it, though."

name: Mother
message: "If you don't mind, we'd love it if you came to see us again. Goodbye now~"

name: Shiori
message: "Of course, goodbye."

name: Shiori
message: "She really can see me."

name: Shiori
message: "She may be unrelated to our ghost, but there's still a chance she's seen something somewhere."

name: Shiori
message: "I'm... a little hesitant to bring up children in front of her..."

name: Shiori
message: "It may just be me, but I'm sure she's carrying some kind of child-related trauma... and I don't want to carelessly dig at her wounds..."

name: Shiori
message: "Can I be honest?"

name: Shiori
message: "I've been coming up with all sorts of excuses, but... I'm actually just scared."

name: Shiori
message: "Not of her... but of me slipping up."

name: Shiori
message: "You know how she was so friendly right from the get-go? I'm not good at judging the right distance with people, so..."

name: Shiori
message: "I never thought I'd still be worrying about social boundaries even after becoming a ghost."

name: Shiori
message: "If we happen to run into her again, and the timing feels right... maybe we can ask her a few things."

name: Shiori
message: "When does the timing feel 'right,' anyway?"

name: Shiori
message: "We should go."

name: Shiori
message: "She can definitely see ghosts, but... something's tugging at me."

name: Shiori
message: "That said... we don't have any reason to get more involved with her right now."

name: Shiori
message: "There's nothing else for us to do here, so let's head somewhere else."

name: Shiori
message: "Uribayashi Rina-san... a woman involved in a kidnapping case in the past..."

name: Shiori
message: "But that doesn't mean we should immediately link her to that case."

name: Shiori
message: "Let's go. It'd be really awkward if we ran into her."

name: Shiori
message: "Honestly, how could that supermarket lady talk like that? How insensitive could a person get?"
